about.bio: I'm Arun. I build products that feel inevitable once they exist. Right now that means Metzee, a live-auction marketplace where anyone in India can go live, sell and ship in real time. Before that, I spent years in digital marketing, building websites and growing brands through search and social, and earned a Master's in GIS at Sheffield Hallam University. I care about craft, speed and the small details people feel before they notice.

metzee.lede: Metzee is a live-auction marketplace built for India. Buyers bid, pay and track delivery without ever leaving the stream.

cards.title: How it works
cards.text: Sellers broadcast live shows and run auctions in real time. Bidding, payment and delivery tracking all happen inside the stream.

cards.title: Who sells
cards.text: Anyone can sell: resellers, wholesalers, manufacturers and collectors alike.

cards.title: Where it runs
cards.text: A web app and a native Android app, built from one codebase.
